newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING-US Franchise Systems Inc.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING-US Franchise Systems Inc.

text.p: US Franchise Systems Inc said it filed for an initial public offering of 2.325 million shares of Class A common stock.
The Atlanta-based company said it would offer 1.825 million shares and selling shareholders would offer 500,000 shares in the proposed offering.
The franchising company has two brands in the lodging industry, Microtel Inns budget hotel brand and the Hawthorn Suites upscale, extended stay brand.
The company did not include an estimated filing range nor a proposed trading symbol in its regulatory filing.
